title: 阿克尚·小风筝
description: 阿克尚穿完整旅行装，在院子里修补小风筝，复活枪静置在旁边支架。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Akshan is a charming adult man with warm brown skin, swept dark hair, a short neat beard, lively eyes, and his distinctive flowing pale scarf. Adapt his Shuriman adventurer outfit into a fully closed cream tunic, cropped brown jacket, opaque trousers, and boots. Preserve ornate gold details and his recognizable hooked grappling firearm, securely resting on a low stand.
art_direction.scene: On a sunny courtyard stool, he repairs the loose corner of a small diamond kite using a short strip of cloth. The scarf curls softly behind his shoulder, echoing the kite tail laid across the table. Include one clay plant pot and a pale archway. His equipment stays still while his smile focuses on the little craft.
art_direction.palette: sand cream, turquoise, chestnut brown, soft gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
